dict.string: The Perch reads your health data (weight, sleep, heart rate) to display trends and insights on your dashboard.
The Perch writes health metrics synced from your OpenClaw agents to Apple Health for safekeeping.
The Perch uses the camera to capture meals, receipts, boarding passes, and other items you log from the compose button.
The Perch lets you attach photos from your library to meals, receipts, and other items you log.
